parsedVerdict.reasoning: Most of BoxOffice fits the domain layer. It enforces business rules (1–8 seats per purchase, no sales after the event has started), coordinates the Event and Ticket entities, and reaches storage only through injected stores. One part does not fit: `admit(code: string, request?: Request)` takes the Express HTTP `Request` type as a parameter. That puts transport and framework concerns into the domain service's API, even though the parameter is never used. Handling HTTP requests belongs to the presentation layer (TicketController), not to a domain service. A smaller, borderline issue: the service rebuilds entities from raw stored rows (e.g. `new Event(data.id, data.title, ...)`), which is mapping work normally done by the persistence layer. I treated this as secondary. The Express type in the signature is the main reason the file fails. I did not judge import direction, which is out of scope.
